sentences.cn_text: 我是一名在动物园和野生动物园工作多年的员工。
sentences.en_text: I am a zoo and wildlife park employee for years.

sentences.cn_text: 野生动物园和动物园均声称其运营是为了动物福祉和保护目的。
sentences.en_text: Both the wildlife park and zoo claimed to be operating for the benefit of the animals and for conservation purposes.

sentences.cn_text: 这一说法是虚假的。
sentences.en_text: This claim was false.

sentences.cn_text: 它们实际上都未参与任何动物研究或保护工作。
sentences.en_text: Neither one of them actually participated in any contributions to animal research or conservation.

sentences.cn_text: 它们是盈利性机构，其利润底线远比动物状况重要。
sentences.en_text: They are profitable institutions whose bottom line is much more important than the condition of the animals.

sentences.cn_text: 动物厌恶被囚禁在动物园中。
sentences.en_text: Animals despise being captives in zoos.

sentences.cn_text: 无论如何「改善」围栏，它们都无法提供自由、自然饮食或充足的运动。
sentences.en_text: No matter how you “enhance” enclosures, they do not allow for freedom, a natural diet or adequate exercise.

sentences.cn_text: 这些机构早该实现透明化，动物园也早该从我们的文化中消除。
sentences.en_text: It’s past time for transparency with these institutions, and it’s past time to eliminate zoos from our culture.

sentences.cn_text: 作为一名动物学教授,我同意艾玛·马里斯的观点,即动物园展示可能令人悲伤且残酷。
sentences.en_text: As a zoology professor, I agree with Emma Marris that zoo displays can be sad and cruel.

sentences.cn_text: 但她低估了动物园的教育价值。
sentences.en_text: But she underestimates the educational value of zoos.

sentences.cn_text: 我所在大学的动物学专业吸引了许多学生,对他们而言,动物园参观是引领他们主修生物科学的关键性成长经历。
sentences.en_text: The zoology program at my university attracts students for whom zoo visits were the crucial formative experience that led them to major in biological sciences.

sentences.cn_text: 这些学生大多在孩童时期没有机会前往荒野地区、野生动物保护区或国家公园。
sentences.en_text: These are mostly students who had no opportunity as children to travel to wilderness areas, wildlife refuges or national parks.

sentences.cn_text: 虽然优秀的电视节目能够激发孩子对保护工作的兴趣,但它们无法取代动物园参观所带来的那种强烈、沉浸式和互动性的体验。
sentences.en_text: Although good TV shows can help stir children’s interest in conservation, they cannot replace the excitement of a zoo visit as an intense, immersive and interactive experience.

sentences.cn_text: 必然存在某种中间立场,能够在动物园对动物的对待与其教育潜力之间取得平衡。
sentences.en_text: Surely there must be some middle ground that balances zoos’ treatment of animals with their educational potential.

sentences.cn_text: 艾玛·马里斯的文章是对成千上万为改善动物生活和保护地球而不懈努力的热忱人士的侮辱和伤害。
sentences.en_text: Emma Marris’s article is an insult and a disservice to the thousands of passionate people who work tirelessly to improve the lives of animals and protect our planet.

sentences.cn_text: 她利用过时的研究和数十年前的案例来削弱那些致力于让儿童接触更广阔世界的组织的崇高使命。
sentences.en_text: She uses outdated research and decades-old examples to undermine the noble mission of organizations committed to connecting children to a world beyond their own.

sentences.cn_text: 动物园处于保护工作的前沿,并不断改进照护动物的方式以及保护各物种在其自然栖息地的生存。
sentences.en_text: Zoos are at the forefront of conservation and constantly evolving to improve how they care for animals and protect each species in its natural habitat.

sentences.cn_text: 是否会有悲剧发生?
sentences.en_text: Are there tragedies?

sentences.cn_text: 当然会。
sentences.en_text: Of course.

sentences.cn_text: 但这些是例外情况,而非马里斯女士所暗示的常态。
sentences.en_text: But they are the exception, not the norm that Ms. Marris implies.

sentences.cn_text: 动物园中处于困境的动物所获得的治疗,不亚于甚至优于我们大多数人在当地医院所得到的治疗。
sentences.en_text: A distressed animal in a zoo will get as good or better treatment than most of us at our local hospital.

sentences.cn_text: 作为一名环保主义者、动物保护倡导者和长期素食者,我本应在动物园问题上与艾玛·马里斯持相同立场。
sentences.en_text: As a fellow environmentalist, animal-protection advocate and longtime vegetarian, I could properly be in the same camp as Emma Marris on the issue of zoos.

sentences.cn_text: 但我相信,管理良好的动物园以及那些忍受圈养之苦的英勇动物,确实服务于更高的目标。
sentences.en_text: But I believe that well-run zoos, and the heroic animals that suffer their captivity, do serve a higher purpose.

sentences.cn_text: 若非有机会在家附近观察这些美丽的野生生物,更多的人将会在好奇心驱使下前往荒野地区寻找、打扰甚至猎杀它们。
sentences.en_text: Were it not for opportunities to observe these beautiful, wild creatures close to home, many more people would be driven by their fascination to travel to wild areas to seek out, disturb and even hunt them down.

sentences.cn_text: 从这个意义上说,动物园类似于自然历史和考古博物馆,在满足我们与这些生物接触的需求的同时,让绝大多数生物在其自然环境中不受干扰。
sentences.en_text: Zoos are, in that sense, similar to natural history and archaeology museums, serving to satisfy our need for contact with these living creatures while leaving the vast majority undisturbed in their natural environments.

sentences.cn_text: 艾玛·马里斯选择性地描述并曲解了我们的研究发现。
sentences.en_text: Emma Marris selectively describes and misrepresents the findings of our research.

sentences.cn_text: 我们的研究聚焦于动物园体验对人们如何看待自身与自然的影响,从我们研究中提取的数据点绝不会削弱动物园参观的学习价值。
sentences.en_text: Our studies focused on the impact of zoo experiences on how people think about themselves and nature, and the data points extracted from our studies do not, in any way, discount what is learned in a zoo visit.

sentences.cn_text: 动物园是思考的工具。
sentences.en_text: Zoos are tools for thinking.

sentences.cn_text: 我们的研究为动物园在连接人类与动物及自然方面的价值提供了有力支持。
sentences.en_text: Our research provides strong support for the value of zoos in connecting people with animals and with nature.

sentences.cn_text: 动物园为保护和环境保护提供了重要的发声平台。
sentences.en_text: Zoos provide a critical voice for conservation and environmental protection.

sentences.cn_text: 它们为来自各种背景的人们提供了接触多种动物的机会,从雄蜂到跳羚或鲑鱼,以更好地理解我们所生活的自然世界。
sentences.en_text: They afford an opportunity for people from all backgrounds to encounter a range of animals, from drone bees to springbok or salmon, to better understand the natural world we live in.

sentences.cn_text: 不遗余力照护动物的动物园不应遭受不公正的批评。
sentences.en_text: Zoos which spare no effort to take care of animals should not be subjected to unfair criticism.

sentences.cn_text: 迫使动物园减少对动物的投入将导致它们照护的珍贵生物遭受非人道待遇。
sentences.en_text: To pressure zoos to spend less on their animals would lead to inhumane outcomes for the precious creatures in their care.

sentences.cn_text: 虽然圈养动物值得同情,但动物园在引导年轻人走上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。
sentences.en_text: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.

sentences.cn_text: 动物园使人们无需前往荒野地区,从而有助于野生动物保护。
sentences.en_text: Zoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.

sentences.cn_text: 对于无法回归自然栖息地的野生动物而言,动物园提供了最佳替代方案。
sentences.en_text: For wild animals that cannot be returned to their natural habitats, zoos offer the best alternative.

sentences.cn_text: 动物园本应被关闭,因为它们将营利置于动物福祉之上。
sentences.en_text: Zoos should have been closed down as they prioritize money making over animals’ wellbeing.

sentences.cn_text: 马里斯曲解了我们的研究结果,而这些结果实际上证明动物园是人与自然之间不可或缺的纽带。
sentences.en_text: Marris distorts our findings which actually prove that zoos serve as an indispensable link between man and nature.
